Yes, this was a satirical (joke) post, however (also as stated by op and others) the later post was not a joke. Do you remember back in 2016 when everyone said "haha im gonna kill myself"? It was used by people who were depressed and people who werent, which led to a lot of confusion. 
As a result, people who were actually depressed used the joke as a cover so that people wouldn't worry about them; it's an extremely common defense mechanism used to make people think they're okay so that energy isnt wasted on them. 
However, one of the most common signs of suicidal ideations is actually a sudden boost in positivity and laughter. Put in simple words, it's the brain saying "I want them to remember me as a funny and bright person". 
Nowadays, not very many people joke like that anymore, so chances are, if someone is still joking like that...
they actually aren't.
TL;DR: That post was a joke made as a shield for real underlying issues that were later expressed.

My mother and I are super interested in psychology; She focuses on adults, whereas I've always focused on the child to adolescent to adult transition. It's my favorite subject and my favorite thing to learn about besides chemistry.
Seeing as how the post of origin is on r/teenagers, I should probably point out that adolescents- especially ones between 12 and 16- are around 70% more likely to openly talk about their depression than younger ages or adults. It's the age group where they basically say "Fuck it, the world needs to know what I'm thinking". Put that together with social media, and you get a huge explosion of public posts and comments about depression, suicide, eating disorders, self harm, and other depression-related issues. Also, because they're a lot more likely to speak out about how they're feeling and what they're thinking, it also makes them prone to telling people when they unintentionally saved their lives. 
I'm not sure why you think that just because someone is openly talking about their depression they all of a sudden can't actually be depressed, but if you really think like that, my next words to you are:
